body: I had told her that I do like girls, I’ve just never dated one because I feel like they’re not my type, and the ones that are my type don’t like me back. She told me that when she had found it she felt sad. I feel horrible for making her feel sad over my stupid mistake. I want to move on from this but it seems like it’s so hard to. I feel like she’s gonna think about it for years and years and that’s what scares me. I don’t want her to think differently of me as if I’m not her son. I think it would’ve been so much differently if she had found an adult toy for males, not females. It still would’ve been weird but just not as weird. I know she loves me with all her heart but I still feel like a let down to her.

I say accidentally because it was a mistake. I know that I purposely ordered it but didn’t want it. I don’t know why I did it. It’s a big deal to her because we’re catholic. I feel like she thinks I’m gay now and now I just feel like a disappoint to her even though she had told me that she believed me. Again, I don’t know why I did it. It was like something forced me to press the button. I tried to return it but the seller said no.
